chapters.title: Subscription, billing and free trial
intro: This chapter is for administrators who look after the SupportDesk subscription. It covers your plan, usage and limits, plan changes, invoices, payment and suspension.
It also shows how a new company starts a free trial of SupportDesk.

sections.title: The Subscription page
intro: Open it with **Subscription** in the left rail, or with **Administration** > **Subscription & billing**. You need the **Manage subscription, plan and billing** permission.
The page keeps working while your workspace is suspended, so that you can always pay.

blocks.caption: The **Subscription** page of the demo workspace. A banner warns that payment is overdue.
blocks.alt: Subscription page with the plan, usage meters, usage history chart, invoices and billing contact

callouts: **Compare & change plan** opens the plan comparison. **Refresh** loads the page again.
**Current plan**: the plan, the price per agent, seats, billing cycle, period, next invoice, payment method and included features.
**Usage history** for one measure over 30 days, 90 days or 12 months.
**Invoices**, each with a button that downloads its PDF.
**Billing contact**: where invoices are addressed and sent.

blocks.p: A banner at the top tells you when something needs action. It shows the days left in a trial, an overdue payment, a suspension, or a plan change booked for later.

sections.title: Subscription statuses
sections.intro: The badge on the **Current plan** card shows the state of your subscription.

rows: You are trying SupportDesk. Everything in the chosen plan is available. The banner shows the days left.
The subscription is paid and up to date.
A trial ended without a paid plan, or an invoice is overdue. The workspace keeps working until the grace period ends.
The grace period ended. People can sign in, read and pay, but cannot change anything.
The subscription has ended. Contact your SupportDesk provider.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.intro: Each plan sets limits. The **Usage vs limits** card compares your use with them, and refreshes every 15 minutes.

list: The measures are agents, light agents, portal users, storage, channels and attachments.
AI tokens and calls from other systems count for the current month only.
A bar turns amber at 80 % and shows the percentage used.
Over the limit, the card says **Over the plan limit — new items are blocked.** You cannot add more until you upgrade or remove some.
**unlimited** means the plan sets no limit for that measure.

blocks.p: In **Usage history**, choose a measure and a range to see how use changed. SupportDesk records usage once a day.

sections.title: Compare plans and change your plan
sections.intro: Change your plan, your number of seats or your billing cycle. The app shows the cost before anything changes.

steps.text: On the **Subscription** page, select **Compare & change plan**.
steps.caption: The **Compare plans** panel. The current plan is shaded and marked **Current**.
steps.alt: Compare plans panel with seats, billing cycle and a table of prices, limits and features for four plans

steps: In **Seats (agent licences)**, enter the number of agent licences.
In **Billing cycle**, choose **Monthly** or **Annual (2 months free)**.
Under the plan you want, select **Select**. For your current plan, select **Change seats**.

steps.text: Read the preview. It shows what you pay now and per period from then on.
steps.caption: The preview for a move from Enterprise to Professional, which starts at the end of the period.
steps.alt: Plan change preview with the effective date, the new price and the Back and Schedule change buttons

steps: Select **Upgrade now**, **Apply now** or **Schedule change**. To choose again, select **Back**.
sections.result: The app shows **Subscription updated**. A booked change appears in a banner on the **Subscription** page.

blocks.note: You are never billed for fewer seats than you have active agents. Once you pay for a plan, you cannot go back to **Trial**.

sections.title: When a plan change takes effect
sections.intro: This table shows when each kind of change starts and how it is billed.

rows: A new period starts, with a new invoice.
An invoice for the rest of the current period, pro rata.
At the end of the current period
No charge now. You can cancel the booked change.
Fewer seats on the same plan

blocks.note: The app refuses any change that your current usage does not fit. For example, you cannot move to a plan that allows fewer agents than you have. The preview lists each conflict.

sections.title: Cancel a booked plan change
sections.intro: Keep your current plan after you booked a downgrade for the end of the period.
steps: Open the **Subscription** page.
In the banner that says when your plan changes, select **Keep** and your current plan's name.
sections.result: The app shows **Scheduled change cancelled**. The banner disappears.

sections.title: View and download an invoice
sections.intro: Open an invoice to check it, or download it as a PDF for your accounts team.
steps: On the **Subscription** page, go to the **Invoices** card.

steps.caption: An open subscription invoice with its lines, totals and payment instructions.
steps.alt: Invoice panel with period, dates, bill-to details, invoice lines, totals, how to pay and Download PDF

steps: Check the period, the dates, the bill-to details and the lines.
Select **Download PDF**.
sections.result: Your browser saves the invoice as a PDF file.

blocks.tip: To download without opening the invoice, select the download button at the end of its row.

rows: Open, and the due date has passed.
Your SupportDesk provider recorded the payment.
Cancelled by your SupportDesk provider. Do not pay it.

sections.title: Update the billing contact
sections.intro: Keep the billing contact current, so that invoices reach the right person.
steps: On the **Subscription** page, go to the **Billing contact** card.
Enter the **Name** and **E-mail** of the person who receives invoices.
Enter the **Billing address** and your **Tax id (GSTIN / VAT)** if your invoices need them.
Select **Save contact**.
sections.result: The app shows **Billing contact saved**. New invoices use these details.

sections.title: Paying invoices and suspension
intro: You pay invoices offline by bank transfer. Each invoice shows **How to pay**. Quote the invoice number as the payment reference.
Your SupportDesk provider marks the invoice paid when the money arrives. SupportDesk never stores card details.

blocks.heading: What happens when a payment is late

rows: A trial ended, or an invoice is overdue. A grace period starts, usually 7 days. The workspace keeps working.
The grace period ended. People can still sign in, read and pay. The app refuses other changes with a message that the account is suspended.
When you pay all overdue invoices, the workspace works normally again.

blocks.note: During a suspension, the **Subscription** page and the customer portal still work.

blocks.p: You cannot cancel the subscription yourself. Contact your SupportDesk provider.

sections.title: The free trial
intro: A new company can try SupportDesk without a card. The trial gives a new workspace with 3 seats and every feature of the chosen plan.
The trial lasts at least 14 days. The person who signs up becomes the workspace's administrator.

blocks.p: During the trial, a banner on the **Subscription** page shows the days left. Select **Choose a plan** to move to a paid plan at any time.
If the trial ends without a paid plan, the subscription becomes **Past due**. After the grace period, the workspace is suspended.

sections.title: Start a free trial
sections.intro: Create a new SupportDesk workspace for your company. You do not need an account yet.
prerequisites: A work e-mail address that you can open now.
steps: On the SupportDesk sign-in page, select **Start a free trial**.
Enter your **Company name**. SupportDesk suggests a **Workspace name** from it.

steps.note: A green tick means the name is free. If someone already uses it, select the suggested name.

steps: Enter **Your name** and your **Work e-mail**.
Enter a **Password** of at least 10 characters, with upper-case and lower-case letters and a digit.
In **Plan to try**, choose a plan.

steps.caption: The **Start your free trial** form for a sample company. The green tick shows the workspace name is free.
steps.alt: Start your free trial form with company, workspace name, your name, work e-mail, password and plan

sections.result: The **Check your inbox** page opens. SupportDesk sends a 6-digit code to your e-mail.

sections.title: Verify your e-mail and open your workspace
sections.intro: Finish the sign-up with the code from your e-mail.
steps: Open the e-mail from SupportDesk, and note the 6-digit code.
On the **Check your inbox** page, enter it in **Verification code**.
Select **Verify and create workspace**.
On the **Your workspace is ready** page, select **Sign in to** and your workspace name.
Sign in with your work e-mail and password.
sections.result: Your new workspace opens, with you as its administrator.

blocks.note: The code expires after 30 minutes, and you can try it 5 times. To fix a typing mistake in your details, select **Change details**.

troubleshooting.problem: A plan change is refused because current usage does not fit the plan.
troubleshooting.cause: You use more agents, portal users, storage or channels than the new plan allows.
troubleshooting.fix: Read the conflicts in the preview. Reduce your usage, or choose a larger plan.

troubleshooting.problem: A usage meter says **Over the plan limit — new items are blocked.**
troubleshooting.cause: You reached a hard limit of your plan.
troubleshooting.fix: Upgrade the plan, or remove items you no longer need.

troubleshooting.problem: Every change fails with a message that the account is suspended.
troubleshooting.cause: Invoices stayed unpaid after the grace period.
troubleshooting.fix: Pay the overdue invoices by bank transfer. The **Subscription** page lists them. If you already paid, contact your SupportDesk provider.

troubleshooting.problem: The sign-up form says the workspace name is not available.
troubleshooting.cause: Another company uses that name, or it is reserved.
troubleshooting.fix: Select the suggested name, or enter another one of at least 3 letters or digits.

troubleshooting.problem: The sign-up code does not work.
troubleshooting.cause: The code expired after 30 minutes, or you used all 5 attempts.
troubleshooting.fix: Select **Change details**, and send the form again for a new code.

faq.q: How do we pay SupportDesk invoices?
faq.a: By bank transfer. Each invoice shows how to pay. Quote the invoice number as the payment reference.

faq.q: What happens when our trial ends?
faq.a: The subscription becomes past due, and a grace period starts. Choose a paid plan before it ends to avoid suspension.

faq.q: Can we cancel our subscription ourselves?
faq.a: No. Contact your SupportDesk provider to cancel.

glossary.definition: The package you pay for. It sets the price per agent, the limits and the included features.
How often you pay: monthly, or annually with two months free.
The days after a missed payment or an ended trial when the workspace still works normally.
The state after the grace period. People can sign in, read and pay, but cannot change anything.
Charged only for the part of the period that remains.
A new workspace you can use free for at least 14 days, with every feature of the chosen plan.
